title: 56th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/56/2024).
First reading of the Bill to amend the Drugs Act (Law No. 17/2011), submitted on behalf of the government by Gan MP Yoosuf Nasheed.
First reading of the Attorney General's Office Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu South MP Abdulla Rifau.
Economic Committee report on its review of the Bill to amend the Copyright and Related Rights Act (Law No. 23/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to give first reading to the Drugs Act amendment and the Attorney General's Office Bill, and to take up the Economic Committee's report on the Copyright Act amendment.
